storySection.title: Redefining a Beloved Classic
paragraphs: Munch has always been a playful, mass-market chocolate wafer brand loved across India. But Nestlé saw a new opportunity — to evolve Munch into a more premium, indulgent variant: Munch Max.

The challenge was ambitious: how do you transform a familiar favorite into a premium hero without losing its core identity? How do you craft branding and marketing that appeals to loyal fans and excites new audiences craving something 'extra'?

That’s where Prakria, a top creative agency and trusted branding consultant, stepped in. With expertise in brand building, brand strategy, and creative logo design, we helped Munch Max carve out a bold new identity.

challenge.title: Why PRAKRIA?
challenge.description: Nestlé had already seen the impact of working with us across multiple design and communication projects. They needed more than a vendor — they needed a partner who understood cultural nuance and global brand consistency. With deep expertise as one of India’s leading branding and creative marketing agencies, we united strategy, storytelling, and design to give Munch Max a scalable identity that was both fresh and authentic.

startageySection.title: Our Idea — The Munch Max Identity
startageySection.description: We defined the strategic gap — Munch Max needed to feel bolder, richer, and more intense, while retaining the playful energy that made Munch iconic.

list.title: Naming & Identity Creation
list.description: The name 'Munch Max' was chosen to be short, punchy, and clear — signaling more chocolate, more texture, and more indulgence. This defined the product’s unique positioning.

list.title: Logo & Visual Identity
list.description: We turned the 'X' in 'Max' into a visual powerhouse — a dynamic mark embodying intensity and energy. This became the anchor of all brand communication.

list.title: Packaging & Displays
list.description: We extended the identity into packaging, in-store displays, and campaign visuals. Every element reflected the premium yet playful positioning of Munch Max.

list.title: Brand Narrative
list.description: Our visual storytelling captured both heritage and innovation — showing Munch Max as a bold evolution rather than a departure from its roots.

executionSection.title: How We Brought It to Life

list.title: Brand Strategy
list.description: We positioned Munch Max as a sub-premium extension under Munch, employing bold motifs and impactful typography to signal a change in experience.

list.title: Brand Promotion
list.description: We delivered strong visual storytelling and standout visibility in competitive retail environments and digital channels.

The challenge: introduce a limited-edition KitKat Goa packaging range that captures the essence of Goa, appeals to locals and tourists alike, and cuts through on the shelf.

This was more than a simple pack tweak — it was a brand building opportunity. How do you turn geography into a narrative? How do you balance global brand standards with local soul? Prakria was chosen to lead this branding and marketing strategy journey, acting as creative architects of KitKat’s Goa incarnation.

The team at KitKat needed an agency that could respect brand strategy, operate within branding consultants’ sensibilities, and still dive deep into local flavor. Prakria, with its proven expertise blending global guidelines and local insight, was perfectly positioned.
